title: The GitHub Action fails a pull request while it adds open high-stakes guesses
why: A gate makes the ledger matter in teams; this repository's own workflow uses report-only mode
alternatives: Report only by default; teams opt in to failing

resolution.decision: Report only by default; teams opt in to failing
resolution.note: Owner delegated this call ("you decide what is best"). A first install should never turn CI red; teams opt in with fail-on: high.
